invert_image: invert an input image to extract latents and noise maps for subsequent LEDits++ editing
edit_image_with_prompt: edit an inverted image using LEDits++ with text prompts, guidance scale, and masking thresholds
store_attention_maps: store cross-attention and self-attention maps during diffusion steps for visualization and masking
apply_gaussian_smoothing: apply a 2D Gaussian smoothing filter to attention maps for spatial regularization
rescale_noise_cfg: rescale guidance noise predictions to fix overexposure based on guidance rescale factor
